integrity: Analytic inequalities, equality cases and limiting extremizers are proved in RESULT.md. Finite numerical checks in verify.py are corroborative only. Historical priority is provisional; no external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to Euclidean orthogonal-corner simplices with strictly positive arms; no assertion for arbitrary simplices. The upper bound is nonattained for dimension at least three, while the lower constant is an infimum but no equality for a nondegenerate simplex. Normalization is unnormalized unit-sphere angle.
title: Sharp minimum-angle/fullness constants for orthogonal-corner simplices
